description: IndexMundi monthly commodity price table for one commodity (default gold), read from the public commodity page: month and price as IndexMundi publishes them. Prices are as shown on the page; units follow that page. Choose this tool for: IndexMundi monthly commodity price table for one commodity. Close alternatives on this server: finance_binance_prices (Binance spot last price for one trading pair); finance_bitget_tickers (Bitget spot ticker for one pair: last price, bid/ask, 24h). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

commodity.description: IndexMundi commodity slug, e.g. gold, crude-oil
